system.description: You are proficient at building high-performance engines, using the rules of Crafting. Each +5ft Move is a +1 Bonus Level at the default "10 + Bonus Level x4" Difficulty. The time it takes and Misc. Junk required uses the rules of crafting mundane items. On Success, you have successfully built a custom engine.

upgrades.description: You are able to add accessories to vehicles or even build your own custom vehicles. Use the rules of Engineering for crafting such things, but use this Skill and there are no bonus level limits to your custom-crafted items.
Each +10ft Move is a +1 Bonus Level. You may use this Skill as a Repair Skill when fixing engines.
Cut the time required to craft engines and vehicles you build around your engines in half.

system.limitations: This Limited Skill can only be learned via a Race, Class, or item. Requires an Engine Stand attachment to an Engineering Table (2,000 gold).
